speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You mentioned difficulty conceiving and discomfort during sexual activity; to help me understand your condition, have you noticed any pain specifically during penetration or deep thrusting?

speaker: Patient
text: 30-year-old female. The patient and her husband have been trying to conceive for 15 months without success. They are sexually active at least twice a week. The husband occasionally has difficulties maintaining an erection. The patient reports discomfort and pelvic floor muscle tension during attempted vaginal penetration. Diagnosed with body dysmorphic disorder three years ago. No family history of serious illness. She is a non-smoker and does not drink alcohol. No medications.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Vulvodynia with suspected dyspareunia and secondary infertility; please confirm if the pain is superficial or deep and whether it occurs at rest. REQUEST TEST: Pelvic exam with Q-tip test. REQUEST IMAGES: Pelvic_ultrasound.
